# MC4007 - Dual binary to one-of-four line decoder (MTTL)

Package DIP-16 · family MC4000 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/MC4007.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/MC4007.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 54 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![MC4007 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/MC4007.png) | ![MC4007 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-MC4007.png) | ![MC4007 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-MC4007.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Q3_1 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 2 | Q2_1 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 3 | Q1_1 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 4 | Q0_1 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 5 | E1 | enable | low |  | controls pins 4, 3, 2, 1 |
| 6 | X1 | input |  |  |  |
| 7 | Y1 | input |  |  |  |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 9 | Y2 | input |  |  |  |
| 10 | X2 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | E2 | enable | low |  | controls pins 12, 13, 14, 15 |
| 12 | Q0_2 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 13 | Q1_2 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 14 | Q2_2 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 15 | Q3_2 | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 4,12 | Q0 = NOT (E' AND X' AND Y') | Q0 low when enabled and X=0, Y=0. |
| 3,13 | Q1 = NOT (E' AND X AND Y') | Q1 low when enabled and X=1, Y=0. |
| 2,14 | Q2 = NOT (E' AND X' AND Y) | Q2 low when enabled and X=0, Y=1. |
| 1,15 | Q3 = NOT (E' AND X AND Y) | Q3 low when enabled and X=1, Y=1. The formulas assume all outputs are high when E is high (see unknown). |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -1.6 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | From the test-current table: VOL 0.4 V max at IOL2 16 mA (IOL1 17.6 mA); VOH 2.5 V min at IOH -1.6 mA. Output loading factor 10. 125 mW typ per package. |

## Not known

- Output level with ENABLE high is not in the printed truth table (only E = 0 is shown); whenInactive left null.
- Only typical delays are printed; no minimum or maximum.

## Notes

ND title "Dual 1-of-4 decoder". Outputs are active low.
